item.title: Escambia County Felon Sentenced To Federal Prison For Firearm Possession

item.title: Tate Boys Tennis Beats Milton 7-0
item.description: Thursday, Tate Aggies Boys Tennis beat 7-0 to improve to 5-1 on the season. The Aggie Boys were coming off a 7-0 win over Washington on Tuesday, and a 7-0 win over Escambia on February 12. Up next, Tate will face Navarre. The Tate Girls fell to Milton 5-2 on Thursday.
